Significant Programs and Developments Immunology Skyrizi • In February 2026, AbbVie announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 AFFIRM trial evaluating Skyrizi subcutaneous induction in adult patients with moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease (CD).

Lutikizumab • In October 2026, AbbVie announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 INTREPID study, which evaluated lutikizumab in adults and adolescents with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS).
• In September 2026, AbbVie announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 LUNA study, which evaluated Qulipta for the preventive treatment of menstrual migraine in adults.

Epkinly • In January 2026, AbbVie announced topline results from the Phase 3 EPCORE DLBCL-1 trial evaluating Epkinly compared to investigator's choice of chemoimmunotherapy in adult patients with relapsed/refractory (R/R) diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL).

• In June 2026, AbbVie announced topline results from the Phase 3 EPCORE DLBCL-4 trial evaluating Epkinly plus lenalidomide compared to rituximab plus gemcitabine plus oxaliplatin in adult patients with R/R DLBCL who received at least one prior line of therapy.

• In July 2026, AbbVie announced the EC granted marketing authorization for Tepkinly in combination with lenalidomide and rituximab for the treatment of adult patients with R/R follicular lymphoma (FL). 2026 Form 10-Q | 27 • In October 2026, AbbVie announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 EPCORE DLBCL-2 trial evaluating fixed treatment duration Epkinly in combination with standard of care rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin hydrochloride, vincristine, and prednisone (R-CHOP), compared to R-CHOP alone, in newly diagnosed patients with DLBCL.

Etentamig • In September 2026, AbbVie announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 CERVINO trial evaluating etentamig, a next-generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific T-cell engager versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies in triple-class exposed adults in R/R multiple myeloma (MM).
